cards.title: Functions that take a list
cards.body: A parameter can be a whole list. Inside the function, use it like any other list.

hi.title: List lene wale functions
hi.body: Parameter poori list bhi ho sakta hai. Function ke andar use kisi bhi list ki tarah use karo.

cards.title: Two decimal places
cards.body: In an f-string, `{value:.2f}` shows a number with exactly two digits after the point.

hi.title: Do decimal places
hi.body: f-string mein `{value:.2f}` number ko point ke baad theek do digits ke saath dikhata hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print `2.33`, but prints `2.333333`. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: Two decimal places is `:.2f`, with a dot. Without the dot, `2` sets a width, not the number of decimals.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse `2.33` print karna chahiye, par yeh `2.333333` print karta hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: Do decimal places ke liye `:.2f` chahiye, dot ke saath. Dot ke bina `2` width set karta hai, decimals ki ginti nahi.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 5 / 2 is 2.5, and :.2f always shows two decimals, so it prints 2.50.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: 5 / 2 ka matlab 2.5, aur :.2f hamesha do decimals dikhata hai, isliye 2.50 print hota hai.

exercise.prompt: Write `average(numbers)` that returns the average of a list. Read whole numbers on one line and print their average with two decimal places, like `2.50`.
